method: Complete reads of three pinned C formatters, verifying Git blob and SHA256. Source-level review, no formatter runtime execution.
findings: Summary returns immediately when total_files<=1, before checking aborted/equal-failure state. In this branch explicit early-shutdown warning is omitted even if aborted; no runtime control executed here.

Summary and stats declare uninitialized winsize then call ioctl(TIOCGWINSZ) without checking success before reading ws_col. Aborted output redirected to a nonterminal can reach this source path; undefined-value behavior not executed.

Summary labels existing readable formatter paths as written using access(R_OK), without checking stream write/flush result. It describes replay as no I/O despite replay code reading report and filesystem metadata; this should not be interpreted as a fresh content validation.

Stats uses aggregate byte counters for efficiency; multiplication/division occurs in counter arithmetic before assignment to gfloat. Ratios are not independent correctness, peak-memory or speed measurements. Formatting ignores output errors.

Pretty formatter omits unique, directory-member and traversed-directory candidate records, distinguishes original rows with listing commands and quotes embedded apostrophes in paths. It remains human presentation, not a complete machine-readable partition or execution receipt.
limits: Source-level potential failure cases only; no full-program or undefined-behavior reproduction.
